details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> graph: gather the recurrent states once so the reserve covers every split (#29856) build_rs gathered the extra states (n_rs - n_seqs rows) with their own get_rows. The worst-case reserve has n_rs == n_seqs, so that node was sized at zero rows, and any ubatch whose cells are not contiguous forced a graph reallocation at an unchanged node count, which aborts under GGML_SCHED_NO_REALLOC. A single get_rows now gathers the n_rs states: the ubatch states and the extra states are views of it, and its size only depends on n_rs, which the reserve already sets to the maximum. A custom getter (mamba ssm_scan) gathers from the second state, so a single sequence ubatch copies no state.
